description: bits-ui's Dialog as shadcn-svelte's Sheet, compiled from its published source through the unmodified sheet, button, input and label wrappers and the sheet-demo (the content on the right, three quarters of the viewport wide up to max-w-sm, sliding in and out). Opened from the trigger by Enter, the content focused on its first input; typing into both inputs, Tab through Save, Close and the close icon, Escape closing it with focus back on the trigger; reopened and closed by a press outside the content (on the overlay: `covered`); reopened and closed by the Close button. The body scroll lock, the portal, the open and close animations, aria and data-state attributes
